cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under themes preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the themes preferences and verify that both Classic and Modern themes are present and listed.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display
cases.description: Verify that the Classic theme is displayed correctly as shown in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Modern theme display against reference image
cases.description: Navigate to the Modern theme and verify that it is displayed correctly as shown in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item under View menu
cases.description: Navigate to the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the Get New Themes item is available.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and verify that the 'Classic' item is present and available for selection.

cases.title: Verify Modern item under View menu
cases.description: Open the View menu and confirm that the 'Modern' menu item is present and available.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases adequately cover the requirements for theme preferences and View menu items without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario includes navigating to theme preferences and verifying the existence of both Classic and Modern themes. For R-176: Normal scenario includes verifying that the Classic theme is displayed according to the given image. For R-177: Normal scenario includes verifying that the Modern theme is displayed according to the given image. For R-178: Normal scenario includes opening the View menu and verifying the presence of the Theme Preferences item. For R-179: Normal scenario includes opening the View menu and verifying the presence of the Get New Themes item. For R-180: Normal scenario includes opening the View menu and verifying the presence of the Classic item. For R-181: Normal scenario includes opening the View menu and verifying the presence of the Modern item. All speculative scenarios regarding empty lists, network failures, and display modes have been removed to adhere strictly to requirements R-175 through R-181.
